summary: Correct, minimal fix: when nz is empty, b=self.func()=Add()=0 spuriously makes b.is_zero True, wrongly triggering the imaginary-branch False return; returning None avoids the wrong answer. Safe direction (None over wrong False) and resolves the reported issue.

issues.description: Fix trades precision for safety: some all-imaginary Adds that previously returned a (coincidentally correct) False now return None. Acceptable since is_zero must never give a wrong answer, but slightly less informative in edge cases.
No inline comment explaining why len(nz)==0 must short-circuit to None (empty Add collapses to 0 and misfires b.is_zero); a one-line comment would aid future maintainers.
